items.html: And she ascends in the aspect of a point alone, the entire length of ZA, up to his Keter, back to back. Also in the aspect of a point, and not yet in the aspect of a Partzuf. And see in its place: for there is a second coupling in Aba and Ima, and there is then Mayin Nukvin of Hochma and Bina; and then an illumination is added in her, that she should ascend through all the aspect of the back up to the Keter, in the aspect of a measure or a single point alone.
